description: Request pod deletion. Billing stops when accepted; deletion may finish asynchronously (get_pod shows DELETING). Data on the pod is lost. Removes exactly one pod per call, and only with that pod's removal_token from prepare_removal (valid 30 to 60 minutes) and its current pod_name; otherwise nothing is removed.

pod_id.description: Pod id, as list_pods shows it

pod_name.description: The pod's name as get_pod shows it; nothing is removed if it does not match

removal_token.description: The removal_token prepare_removal returned for this pod

name: remove_pod
title: Remove a Lium pod
